shortBio.en: Depeche Mode lead vocalist from the Basildon lineup onward.
shortBio.zh: Depeche Mode 主唱；自 Basildon 编制起。

body.en: Born 1962, Epping. Lead vocals on Depeche Mode records from Speak & Spell through later albums. Stage presence and baritone delivery sit at the front of the live mix.
body.zh: 1962 年生于 Epping。从《Speak & Spell》起任 Depeche Mode 主唱。现场混音中人声与舞台存在感靠前。
